description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order made to amend the item 05 of the Schedule of Order published under Sec. 3 of Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act No. 12 of 2006 w.e.f. 01.01.2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the amendment of a legal order under the Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 2006. It modifies regulatory provisions related to stamp duty charges on international credit card transactions. While it names the Minister of Finance, this is done in the context of exercising statutory powers to amend a regulation, not to announce a personnel change or assign detailed ministerial portfolios. The core content is regulatory/legal in nature, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5).
